021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.Phase;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
023import org.bukkit.Location;
024import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
026
027/**
028 * ShopTeleportEvent
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @since 6.3.0.4
032 */
033public class ShopTeleportEvent extends ShopEvent {
034
035  protected final Player player;
036  protected Location teleportLocation;
037
038  public ShopTeleportEvent(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull Player player, final @NotNull Location teleportLocation) {
039
040    super(shop);
041    this.player = player;
042    this.teleportLocation = teleportLocation;
043  }
044
045  public ShopTeleportEvent(final Phase phase, final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull Player player, final @NotNull Location teleportLocation) {
046
047    super(phase, shop);
048    this.player = player;
049    this.teleportLocation = teleportLocation;
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Creates a new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase.
054   *
055   * @param newPhase The new Phase for the cloned PhasedEvent
056   *
057   * @return A new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase
058   */
059  @Override
060  public ShopTeleportEvent clone(final Phase newPhase) {
061
062    return new ShopTeleportEvent(newPhase, this.shop, this.player, this.teleportLocation);
063  }
064
065  public Location teleportLocation() {
066
067    return teleportLocation;
068  }
069
070  public void teleportLocation(final Location teleportLocation) {
071
072    this.teleportLocation = teleportLocation;
073  }
074
075  public Player player() {
076
077    return player;
078  }
079}
